findings.issue: The w2 code is correct. The problem is in the e2e suite. The settings test restores `historyTable.locator('tbody tr').last()` (line 593) and publishes it. VersionHistory.tsx:42 sorts by `seq` descending with no limit, so the last row is always seq 1. On this long-lived local database, seq 1 predates `social`. playwright.config.ts runs one worker in alphabetical file order (cms, then owner-operations, public, reader, store-admin, visual), so this follows from the code: (a) after any full e2e run, the live local settings have no social links. public/visual in that run, and any `pnpm build` done afterwards, show the footer without its handle and /contact without its four tiles. visual.spec writes the tracked DESIGN-B screenshots that way. (b) On the next full run, the new cms test fails at `await expect(items).toHaveCount(4)` (cms.spec.ts:279). The suite can no longer be re-run without `pnpm db:import --force` in between. The underlying bug (restoring the oldest version) predates this round. w2 made it matter, because the links now live in the database and the new test requires them. The worker reported this as risk 1 and could not fix it: this file is outside the lock's allowedPaths.
